baseline.method: PhasorPy0.12 two-harmonic graphical search, original full measured run

nrmse_definition: RMS error / reference dynamic range, separately for both output quantities, all pixels with observed histogram total>0; lifetime channels jointly.
reference_role: Independent official implementation result, not biological truth. Bit-exact original rerun; nonzero tolerances frozen before extraction. No per-image rescaling, alignment or cropping.
definition: Every observed pixel must use a prior-grid component lifetime, lie on its first-harmonic component line, use the second-harmonic projection as its fraction, and attain second-harmonic squared perpendicular error no greater than the validated mathematical-grid minimum plus 1e-12. Lifetimes are ordered and positive, fractions in [0,1], background zero. Equivalent near-degenerate minima are allowed; no lifetime or fraction agreement to a selected tie is required.
tolerance_provenance: Version2 geometric tolerances fixed at 1e-7 phasor/fraction/ns and 1e-12 absolute squared phasor objective before candidate comparison; these control equation and discrete-prior accuracy rather than reference tau agreement. Original forward RMS boundary retained unchanged.
